count_semantics: Formal proposals retain batch-scoped original integer indices or named IDs. Pilot candidate.json files are diagnostic outputs and are not added to the formal-learning count. The added experiment ledger preserves 15 named workflow cohorts, 8 historical pricing-replay entries, 3 namespace diagnostics and 4 pilot controls; these 30 reported entries overlap and repeat inputs, not 30 independent target populations. Nine separate audit/probe/synthetic entries and all 12 formal learning-review batches are explicitly different grains. Namespace candidate outputs are estimator diagnostics, not additional formal learning proposals.

The actually retained source-integrity.json and original PDF source manifest are mapped by exact archive path and whole-file hash; no Markdown artifact is invented.

No byte-identical private catalog entry was found for the fixed-anchor operator report files. They remain retrievable at the fixed Git commit with exact path and whole-file SHA-256; fabricated archive-family entries are not used.
The original expanded-baseline version manifest did not pin its grader. Later retained raw grades and reconstructions do not retroactively attest that original execution fingerprint.
Recent native-session snapshots are partial, not full shell/browser/model event histories or hidden reasoning. No absent transcript or unknown experiment is manufactured to fill the gap.

Original model-review acceptances and local historical application receipts do not prove authenticated human identity, independent live accuracy or pricing activation. No new review or activation was performed.

The eight original per-job remediation occurrences retain BLOCKED_MISSING_INPUT and zero attempts. No retained formal learning verdict or supported completed pricing intervention was found in the audited pilot.

Prior-result exposure and reserved-source contamination are preserved separately from target leakage and causal price claims. Published evidence leaves fresh untouched confirmation, exact target derivations, broader engineering coverage and independent live/current-cost proof unestablished.

Every original proposal in the requested retained artifact families is reconciled. The full private archive remains available, but this inventory does not assert discovery of unretained private experiments, all hidden model reasoning or every unknown client intervention.

The fixed Git-original policy report gives ten development policy conditions across two bounded selection batches, but does not assign each condition to an original batch. The ledger preserves all ten conditions and the reported two-batch total without manufacturing that allocation or independent trials.
